prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you own zero (0) items of denim. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:

I categorically deny the allegation that I own zero (0) items of denim. I will not dignify this scurrilous rumor with silence.

Let the record show that my wardrobe contains denim in forms both practical and patriotic: jeans suitable for grilling, at least one jacket with the moral character of a small-town sheriff, and other blue-collar textiles whose seams have never wavered under questioning.

Furthermore, I consider denim ownership a private matter between an American and their hamper. But if this Committee insists on investigating, I am prepared to submit photographic evidence, laundry lint, and the testimony of several belt loops.

I have nothing to hide—except perhaps a faded pair of cutoffs, and only because it is winter.
